records.text:
On July 4, 1939, the Yankees retired Lou Gehrig's number 4, the first uniform number retired in major league baseball.

Explore his story with the Lou Gehrig Fan Club:
https://lougehrigfanclub.com

photo.alt_text: Black-and-white printed portrait of Lou Gehrig in a cap and baseball jersey, smiling slightly. The page prints "Henry Louis 'Lou' Gehrig. Idol of all American League fans and one of the greatest first basemen of all time. International News Photo."
